# GitHub Copilot Instructions

> **Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) first.** It is the main context file of this repository. `CLAUDE.md` only points to it. What follows is a short reminder, not a second source of truth.

This repo is Nicolas Velasquez Lopez's (`unmecaniko`) lab for studying and experimenting with the [R-KNav dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/robotcom/R-KNav_dataset) from Robot.com. It is a working knowledge + experiments repository, not the public portfolio.

- Content language: English. Folder and file names: English.
- Do not commit the dataset, weights, or secrets. Reference data by Hugging Face repo id.
- Do not invent technical facts; mark unknowns with `> ⏳ TODO`.
- Point to the main knowledge base for identity and career: [unmecaniko-projects](https://github.com/UnMecaNiko/unmecaniko-projects).
